title: 第两千三百九十九章 谢瑜的建议让我心动第两千三百九十八章 铜钱岭的内情
content_zh:
“那他的态度呢？”我问。
“没问题。”谢瑜说这三个字的时候，我却敏感的感到了气场并不是太强，能支撑她售出这三个字的底气，估计就是来自银行的债权威力了。
“没问题，就是有问题呀！”我说，“一个人只要不死，还有口气，多少都是想要挣回来的。我当时不也一样吗？老康撤资，我当时都是嗡嗡的！距离死定就那么一口气的光景，还是紫萱伸出了手。现在我对老康，虽然没什么，大家的目标一致嘛！但还有是因为后来他卖了面朝大海给我啊！我赚钱了啊！如果你说赖永昌说同意你们的方案，我怎么能直观的知晓他的态度是真是假呢？毕竟按照刚才我们所说的，我若有意，那么等同他的债务就是用我的收购款来替他还债了啊！”
“所以呀！”谢瑜笑了，“待会儿让他也来参与我们的晚餐。你看呢？”
“得，说了一大通，原来在这儿等着我呢！”我站住原地不动，“你看看，这个位置怎样？”我们刚好站在大坝的中段，恰好是之前不知道是应验还是小强的主意，在这个位置的地面上设置了一个硕大的金属反光坐标点，上面标注了方位，说是度假村最好的全景拍摄位置，并且特意在坐标上搞了一个二维码，教你如何用全景拍摄最全角度的照片，实在不会操作的话，也能从这个二维码里拿来主义，下载一张全景照片：往东是海景，往东南是海滩，往南是山顶石屋，往西南和西是金帆顶，往西北是四十大盗客房和攀枝花树屋还有小火车车站，往北是水库水面和对岸的舌片石，往东北有蓝色小屋和树林还有小火车车站。二维码里甚至有教程告诉你怎么将其他照片里的自己放进这张全景照片里，实在不行，还推荐你去豆包或元宝里p图。
谢瑜看看脚下的定位：“对呀！刚好！都说了啊，瑕不掩瑜，我有光芒，怎怕黑夜呢？”
两人相对一笑。
“这事我有心，但我不会操作。”我说，“面对别人，我就不说出来了。在铜钱岭项目上，看不清楚搞不明白的话，我最多就是不行动，没收益不要紧，最主要没损失呀！”
“你林凡啊，从小到现在，没变！”谢瑜说，“思前想后是褒义，畏手畏脚是贬义，其实都是同一件事，本质上都是为了避免损失，无可厚非。其实这事儿，可以操作的。你愿意，我就说。”
“赐教赐教！”我说，“别保留哈！”
“有资产管理管理公司认识的吗？你如果有，我就不介绍了。有这个公司，让其出面和我们前签名，就是这个公司持有铜钱岭的债权了。然后，资产公司要求赖永昌签名过户。大概就是这样的过程了。在这个过程中，我们银行完成任务，资产公司拿到权证，赖永昌脱离被起诉的可能。”
“这过程，稳妥吗？”我说，“我像个小白啊！不过，这是我可以问问可可，我未来的那一位啊！”
“如果她熟悉，你也可以问问。将我所说的，和她重复一次。或者说，你叫她来，我和她沟通也行。”谢瑜说，“总而言之，就是不要出岔子就行。”
“我怎么觉得这其中有点信息差什么的？”我说，“你不要介意啊！直觉告诉我。”
“当然有信息差啦！”谢瑜倒也大大方方，“我的本意，是将事情解决。到了我这个年龄，主要是求稳。这个债务追索过程，赖永昌贷的款，我们现在肯定是追不回来全部的了，目前类似当不良资产处理，但上头要求尽量追索，我们判定能追回来的，大概也就是最多3-4成，目前标价也是这样啊！如果上架拍卖，标注100%的债权，第一次流拍是肯定的，那么第二次就7折，第三次又要继续下调了，如果经过三四次的话，估计1折都有可能！但是如果真的到了那个时候，你能拍下来？肯定有人和你抬杠的，那可能最终还是回到3-4折这样的幅度了啊！与其等，不如就直接在3-4这个幅度接下来好了！因为真的1折的话，肯定会有人想拿下转手的，给你到3-4成，转手赚一倍，有可能，看上去你不亏？你有心要的话，不就是想要抢时间吗？和自己的项目同步同频嘛！刚才说的走资产公司的流程，也和现在这个做法大同小异。而这期间的信息差时间，我不想去碰，不然会给人说我故意流失国有银行利益，到时候解释不清楚，很麻烦的，我不愿意惹这种麻烦，我还是喜欢自由自在的感觉啊！别吃不到羊肉，还惹一身骚。对了，我不吃羊肉的呢！所以，刚好你愿意，刚好我能接触到你，就这么简单。3-4成，看上去你好像还有下降空间可以等，但刚才说的，你想想，是不是一样？你还赚了时间了。如果，我说如果啊，如果你不介意时间继续等的话，也不是不可以。你看看广州圆项目，一开始标的55亿拍卖，谁买啊？到最近一次，不到11亿，还是没有人买。我们银行就怕这样烂在手上啊！”
“所以你接下这任务，就联系了赖永昌？”我问，“只要他是愿意的，来晚餐也没什么啊！顺让他光明正大的看看我们的实力。”我还将他原来手下冰冰的事儿简单的说了一遍。
“哎，有时就是这么巧的。”谢瑜说，“来来回回，牵牵扯扯的，大家都在一个大圈子里呢！没站在恰好的位置，都不知道有谁没有谁。你看看，刚才那个位置，我很喜欢，四面八方都能看清楚。你们也想得真周到啊！”
“你们这个词用的好。”我说，“单我一个人，哪里做得出这么多想法？你看我依然浓密的发头就知道我可没用太多脑细胞在这个度假村里，脑细胞都是团伙成员们消耗得多。”
content_en:
"What about his attitude?" I asked.
"No problem." When Xie Yu said these three words, I felt sensitively that her aura was not too strong. The confidence that supported her sale of these three words probably came from the bank's creditor power.
"No problem, there is a problem!" I said, "As long as a person survives and still has a breath, he wants to earn back some money. Wasn't it the same for me at the time? When Lao Kang divested his capital, I was buzzing! When he was just one breath away from death, Zixuan still reached out to him. Now I feel for Lao Kang, although it's nothing, everyone's goal Yes! But it’s also because he later sold Facing the Sea to me! I made money! If you say that Lai Yongchang agrees with your plan, how can I intuitively know whether his attitude is true or not? After all, according to what we just said, if I am interested, then I will use my purchase money to pay off his debts!
"So!" Xie Yu smiled, "Let him come to our dinner later. What do you think?"
"Okay, after all the talk, you're waiting for me here!" I stood still, "Look, what's this location like?" We happened to be standing in the middle of the dam. I don't know whether it was fulfilled or Xiaoqiang's idea before, but a huge metal reflective coordinate point was set up on the ground at this location. The direction was marked on it, saying it was the best panoramic shooting location in the resort, and a QR code was specially made on the coordinates to teach How do you use a panorama to take photos from all angles? If you really don’t know how to operate, you can also use this QR code to download a panoramic photo: to the east is the sea view, to the southeast is the beach, to the south is the stone house on the top of the mountain, to the southwest and west are the Golden Sail Ding, to the northwest are the Forty Thieves guest room, the Panzhihua tree house and the small train station, to the north are the water surface of the reservoir and the tongue stone on the other side, and to the northeast are the blue huts and woods and the small train station. There is even a tutorial in the QR code that tells you how to put yourself in other photos into this panoramic photo. If it doesn't work, I recommend you to go to Doubao or Yuanbao to create a photo.
Xie Yu looked at the position of his feet: "Yes! It's just right! I've said it before, my faults don't hide my faults. I have light, so how can I be afraid of the dark night?"
The two smiled at each other.
"I have intentions for this matter, but I don't know how to operate it." I said, "I won't say it to others. Regarding the Tongqianling project, if I can't see clearly or understand it, the most I can do is not take action. It doesn't matter if there is no gain, the most important thing is that there is no loss!"
"You, Lin Fan, haven't changed since you were young!" Xie Yu said, "Thinking carefully is a compliment, being timid is a derogatory meaning. In fact, they are the same thing. In essence, they are all to avoid losses, which is understandable. In fact, this matter can be operated. If you want, I will say it."
"Teach me something!" I said, "Don't hold back!"
"Do you know anyone from the asset management company? If you do, I won't introduce you. If there is this company, let it come forward and sign with us. It means that this company holds the creditor's rights of Tongqianling. Then, the asset company asked Lai Yongchang to sign for the transfer. This is probably the process. In this process, our bank completed the task, the asset company got the warrant, and Lai Yongchang was freed from the possibility of being sued."
"Is this process safe?" I said, "I feel like a novice! But this is something I can ask Coco, my future one!"
"If she is familiar with her, you can also ask. Repeat what I said to her. Or, you can ask her to come and I will communicate with her." Xie Yu said, "In short, just don't make any mistakes."
"Why do I feel like there's some information gap or something?" I said, "Don't mind it! My intuition tells me."
"Of course there is an information gap!" Xie Yu was generous, "My original intention was to resolve the matter. At my age, the main thing is to seek stability. ThisIn the debt recovery process, we will definitely not be able to recover all the money borrowed by Lai Yongchang now. It is currently treated like a non-performing asset, but the superiors require us to recover it as much as possible. We judge that what we can recover is probably at most 30-40%. The current price is also the same! If it is put up for auction and marked with 100% debt, it will definitely fail the first time, then it will be 30% off for the second time, and it will continue to be reduced for the third time. After three or four times, it is estimated that 10% off is possible! But if that time really comes, can you take a photo? There must be someone arguing with you, and it may eventually return to a 30-40% discount! Instead of waiting, it’s better to just start at the range of 3-4! Because if it is really 10% off, someone will definitely want to take it and give it to you at 30-40%. If you resell it, you will make double the profit. It is possible. It doesn’t look like you are losing money? If you have your heart set on it, aren't you just trying to grab time? Synchronize and use the same frequency as your own project! The process of going through the asset company just mentioned is very similar to the current practice. As for the information gap during this period, I don't want to touch it, otherwise people will say that I deliberately lost the interests of the state-owned bank. It will be very troublesome if I can't explain it at that time. I don't want to cause this kind of trouble. I still like the feeling of freedom! Don't miss out on the mutton and make yourself a mess. By the way, I don’t eat mutton! So, if you are willing, I can contact you, it's that simple. 30% to 40%, it seems like you still have room for decline, but what I just said, think about it, is it the same? You've also earned time. If, I say if, if you don’t mind waiting for time, it’s not impossible. Look at the Guangzhou Yuan project. The initial bidding price was 5.5 billion. Who would buy it? As of the latest time, it was less than 1.1 billion and still no one bought it. Our bank is afraid of being ruined like this! "
"So you took on this task and contacted Lai Yongchang? I asked, "As long as he is willing, it's okay to come to dinner!" Let him see our strength openly. "I also briefly told him about his former subordinate Bing Bing.
“Hey, sometimes it’s such a coincidence. "Xie Yu said, "There's so much going back and forth, it's all involved, everyone is in a big circle! I'm not standing in the right place, so I don't know who's there or who's missing. Look, I like that position just now. I can see clearly in all directions. You guys are so thoughtful! "
“You use that word well. "I said, "How can I come up with so many ideas by myself? You can tell by looking at my still thick hair that I didn’t use too many brain cells in this resort. The brain cells were consumed more by the gang members. "
